title: ID0419363-DC/Si-D/FR-[Y2 / PN 312562229/10]CCS connector issue
description:
Reported behaviour/issue: There is a problem on the CCS cable of this charger (CCS1, cable at the left of the charger). Indeed, we can see that the DC- pin blades are offset which can cause overheating problems. Can you plan an intervention with the French team please to change the CCS connector
Solution: N/A
yyyy-mm-dd: 2025-04-16
